title: Jeremiah Bible Quiz - Chapter 11
description: Ten questions on Jeremiah 11: the words of the covenant, a conspiracy in Judah, a gentle lamb led to slaughter, and the men of Anathoth.

questions.text: Who is cursed, according to the opening words Jeremiah must speak?
questions.explanation: Jeremiah is to say, "Cursed is the man who doesn't hear the words of this covenant," which Yahweh commanded their fathers.

answers.text: The man who doesn't hear the words of this covenant
The man who trusts in his own strength
The man who eats unclean food
The man who moves his neighbor's boundary

questions.text: Out of what does Yahweh say He brought the fathers when He led them from Egypt?
questions.explanation: Yahweh commanded the covenant in the day He brought their fathers out of the land of Egypt, out of the iron furnace.

answers.text: Out of the house of bondage
Out of the sea of reeds
Out of the land of darkness

questions.text: How did Jeremiah answer when Yahweh spoke about the oath of a land flowing with milk and honey?
questions.explanation: After Yahweh spoke of establishing the oath sworn to the fathers, Jeremiah answered and said, "Amen, Yahweh."

questions.text: What does Yahweh say is found among the men of Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem?
questions.explanation: Yahweh said to Jeremiah, "A conspiracy is found among the men of Judah, and among the inhabitants of Jerusalem," for they turned back to the iniquities of their forefathers.

questions.text: According to the number of what has Jerusalem set up altars to burn incense to Baal?
questions.explanation: Yahweh says that according to the number of the streets of Jerusalem they have set up altars to the shameful thing, altars to burn incense to Baal.

questions.text: What is Jeremiah told not to do for this people?
questions.explanation: Yahweh says, "Don't pray for this people. Don't lift up cry or prayer for them," for He will not hear them when they cry because of their trouble.

questions.text: By what name did Yahweh once call His people in this chapter?
questions.explanation: Yahweh called your name, "A green olive tree, beautiful with goodly fruit," but with the noise of a great roar He has kindled fire on it.

answers.text: "A choice vine of wholly pure seed"
"A tall cedar of Lebanon by the waters"
"A fruitful fig tree with sweet early figs"
"A green olive tree, beautiful with goodly fruit"

questions.text: To what does Jeremiah compare himself when he did not know of the plans against him?
questions.explanation: He says, "I was like a gentle lamb that is led to the slaughter," not knowing they had devised plans against him.

answers.text: A bird caught in a snare
A gentle lamb led to the slaughter

questions.text: What do the men of Anathoth tell Jeremiah not to do?
questions.explanation: The men of Anathoth, who seek his life, say, "You shall not prophesy in Yahweh's name, that you not die by our hand."

answers.text: Write his words in a scroll

questions.text: How will the sons and daughters of the men of Anathoth die, according to Yahweh?
questions.explanation: Yahweh of Armies says the young men will die by the sword, and their sons and their daughters will die by famine.
